confidence_notes: Meal, beer, and coffee estimates follow Numbeo's June 2026 Xi'an aggregates. Expatistan's October pub-price sample has fewer than 10 entries; cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to local pub beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Direct Xi'an price data inform food and drink anchors; no proxy city was used. Accommodation reflects a major inland Chinese tourist city.
